text:
tia_cs: Hey team — quick sync on Crowbar account capacity activation. Sam from Crowbar asked for runway for tomorrow's quota bump to 12k qps and a 20% burst window. Need confirmation on autoscale policy and a short smoke plan.
omar_sre: Copy. We have the reserved slot ready but need to validate headroom. Current pool config: reserved=12 GPUs, burst_pool=3 GPUs. Autoscale policy currently: scale_up_threshold=70%, scale_down_threshold=30%, cooldown=60s.
lee_eng: I can run a dry load with the shadow tooling. Suggest hitting 9k sustained + 3k p99 spikes for 10m. Will run in staging first.
sam_pmo: Also flag for CS enablement — they want a 30‑minute runbook walkthrough and an ops contact for cutover. Renewal is due in 6 weeks; success here directly impacts the upsell conversation.
tia_cs: Good call. Omar, can we relax the cooldown to 30s for the burst window only? That will help absorb quick ramps.
omar_sre: We can. Proposed tweak: burst_policy: {"cooldown":"30s","scale_step":"+1 GPU","max_burst_gpus":"3"} — will implement for the 24h post-activation window.
lee_eng: I'll prep the load script. Using rps-prober:
```
# run from shadow-worker-02
./rps-prober --target=crowbar-staging.redwood:443 --profile=burst --sustain=600 --rps=9000 --spike=3000
```
lee_eng: Expect ~10–12% token cost variance due to KV cache coldness. Will capture samples and post results.
deploy-bot: Reminder: infra-deploy queued for 1741240200 by omar_sre. Status: pending approval.
sam_pmo: CS enablement window requested 09:00–10:00 PDT tomorrow. Can someone from eng join for 20m? Customer wants walk-through of quota dashboard, trace links, and rollback steps.
tia_cs: I can do the dashboard walkthrough. Lee — can you cover rollback steps and the command to revoke reserved slot?
lee_eng: Yep. Rollback is a single-step API call to the orchestration service:
```
curl -X POST https://infra.redwood/api/v1/reservations/cancel -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"reservation_id":"res-crowbar-1741"}'
```
tia_cs: Perfect. Omar, any risk items to call out?
omar_sre: Two small ones: 1) KMS key rotation scheduled in 48h in eu-west region — not relevant to US but flag if they use cross-region fallbacks. 2) Nightly backup job may increase I/O at 02:00 PDT; plan activation tomorrow morning to avoid overlap.
sam_pmo: Noted. I'll push activation to 11:00 PDT to steer clear of the backup window and to accommodate enablement. Does that work?
lee_eng: Works for me. I'll run the staging dry run at 08:00, post results in this thread. If p99 latency < 200ms and error rate < 0.5% we greenlight.
deploy-bot: infra-deploy approved by tia_cs at 1741240300. Deploy in progress.
tia_cs: Thanks. After deploy completes, Omar, please run the preflight checks (GPU temp, kernel logs, scheduler latency). Copy paste the checklist here when done.
omar_sre: Will do. Quick checklist I'll run:
- nvidia-smi snapshot
- dmesg | tail -n 200
- check scheduler queue length (svc/infra/scheduler-metrics)
- verify autoscale controller logs for errors
I'll post outputs.
sam_pmo: Customer-facing note: I'll draft a short kickoff email with the activation timeline, expected observable metrics (qps, p99, cost delta), and rollback instructions. Will send to tia_cs for sign-off.
tia_cs: Great. One more ask — capture one example failing prompt if we see quality regressions during the load. We want a quick evidence pack for the renewal review.
lee_eng: Will collect qualitative samples and add to the test artifact bucket: s3://redwood-test-artifacts/crowbar/1741239999-samples
omar_sre: Preflight results posted: GPU temps steady ~65C, no kernel OOMs, scheduler queue avg=12 (target <20), autoscale controller OK. Attaching short log excerpt:
```
[autoscale] INFO scaled up +1 GPU at 1741240456 (target util 72%)
[infra] INFO reservation res-crowbar-1741 active
```
lee_eng: Staging load done: sustain 9k rps, 600s: p50=45ms p95=120ms p99=180ms errors=0.28% token-cost uplift ~11%. Samples uploaded.
tia_cs: All green from CS perspective. Sam — send the kickoff email and schedule the 11:00 PDT activation with the customer. I'll join the enablement call.
sam_pmo: Sent. Subject: "Crowbar capacity activation — 11:00 PDT tomorrow". Includes rollback steps and contact list.
deploy-bot: Activation completed at 1741240560. Reservation res-crowbar-1741 now live.
tia_cs: Nice work team :tada: I'll follow up with a short post-activation health check in 60 minutes. If anything drifts we revert.
lee_eng: I'll monitor traces and post any regressions.
omar_sre: I'll keep watch on autoscale telemetry and slack alerting.
sam_pmo: I'll prepare notes for the renewal briefing. This activation is a strong signal for the upsell.
tia_cs: Closing loop here — thanks everyone.
